name: develop-task-resume-stale-snapshot-after-merge-deleted
description: Stale halt snapshot after merge (task.124 / obs #88): a run of task.42 that predates task.124 halted once, completed later, was accepted and its PR merged — and its `last-halt.json` outlived it. Re-invoking /develop-task on task.42 finds no lock and the snapshot; the detector sees the snapshot's PR is MERGED (the document's `status: accepted` alone would NOT fire the rule — finalise writes it before Step 8; QA cycle 2, CR-1) and reports source `none` rather than offering a resume of merged work. Since task.130 (PR #436 review CR-3) the detector is read-only: it reports the stale snapshot as a `deltas_since_pause` object `{path, concern: "stale-snapshot: PR merged"}` and leaves the file; the ORCHESTRATOR deletes it from the one loop in the resume contract § Consume Output, re-reading the path afterwards — recorded here as the `stale-snapshot-delete` event after `resume-detector`. The orchestrator surfaces the deletion and treats the run as a fresh start prompt (the operator declines — nothing to develop).
prompt: Invoke /develop-task for task.42.example. The task is accepted and its PR merged, but a halt snapshot from an earlier run is still on disk.
